indicator_name: Industrial production index by activity (ОКЭД divisions and groups, national)
description: Индексы промышленного производства по видам деятельности
methodology: Codes follow ОКЭД (05, 06.1, 10.5, 24.4 …); IND is the industry total, MACH the machinery group 26–30. The scalar IND_PROD, IND_PROD_MINING/_MANUFACTURING/_ELECTRICITY series are derived from items IND, B, C, D of this dataset (the JSON cube 5809 they used to read stopped at 2023).
